_comment: Patch definitions for the Lovecraft (Curio) client.
These are TEMPLATES showing each locator kind, and they ship disabled.
Verify a target before enabling it: use 'lcmem type <Class>' to see the
predicted field offset, then 'lcmem instances <Class>' and
'lcmem object <addr>' to confirm the live values look right.
Keep to client-side settings. Anything the server owns - currency,
entitlements, inventory, other players - is validated server-side, so
editing it locally changes nothing except your risk of a ban.
type    i8 u8 i16 u16 i32 u32 i64 u64 f32 f64 | bytes (hex string)
enabled patches with false are skipped by 'patch apply'
kind=mono   class, field, instance (index), optional namespace

patches.name: fov
patches.description: Override the camera field of view (CameraFXManager.CameraFOV)

patches.name: fov-control
patches.description: Enable the FOV override flag so CameraFOV is actually used

patches.name: example-module-patch
patches.description: TEMPLATE: write a value at a fixed module offset

patches.name: example-code-patch
patches.description: TEMPLATE: NOP out an instruction found by signature
